data_source: MUSAE GitHub dataset (Rozemberczki et al.), raw files from https://github.com/benedekrozemberczki/musae
node_id_convention: node_id = row index in x and y (0 .. N-1) = id column in git_target.csv
split_method: sklearn train_test_split, stratified on y, two stages
preprocessing: binary feature lists -> 0/1 matrix -> TruncatedSVD to 128 dims (seed 42, unsupervised, labels not used); edges made undirected, duplicates and self-loops removed
